verdict.rationale: Viam ships an official documented CLI (docs.viam.com/cli/reference) supporting data queries, resource control, fleet/org management, and JSON-in/JSON-out API calls that an AI agent can drive directly, with a dedicated guide on using Viam from an agent via shell/SDK. This is agent-friendly and well-documented but lacks independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI itself. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of CLI usage, more detail on agent-specific CLI workflows beyond the single doc page.
